variants.headline: Strike collapses
variants.sub: The union {name} has seen its strike collapse.
variants.body:
The strike by the union {name} has collapsed. The collapse is a result for the labour action, not an established agreement about the underlying dispute. Readers judging {target} should avoid treating it as proof of a particular settlement, a change in wages or a complete account of responsibility.

The gazette records the collapse without describing it as a negotiated settlement. The end of an action and the resolution of a dispute are distinct propositions. A reliable public notice should also avoid assigning a cause to the collapse where the particulars of that cause have not been supplied.

We take a sympathetic view of {target}. Collapse does not prove every adverse claim about the people involved, and a fair hearing should survive an outcome that lends itself to easy recrimination. Care in the public record is part of responsible administration.

variants.headline: Labour action loses its course
variants.sub: The strike by {name} has ended in collapse.
variants.body:
The union {name} has seen its strike collapse. That is serious news for the colony's labour relations, even without the reasons being specified. An assessment of {target} should distinguish the failure of the action from a judgment that every concern behind it has therefore been answered.

variants.headline: A strike ends in collapse
variants.sub: The strike by the union {name} has collapsed.
variants.body:
The strike by {name} has ended in collapse. The report establishes that outcome without describing the circumstances that produced it. For {target}, the question is responsibility in the labour dispute, rather than an invented story about participation, concessions or the conduct of particular workers.

The gazette records the collapse without describing it as a negotiated settlement. The end of an action and the resolution of a dispute are distinct propositions. A reliable public notice should also avoid assigning a cause to the collapse where the particulars of that cause have not been supplied.
